infoLinks.content:

Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

Catch a train or metro to continue your trip between St Leonards and the city. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD, Martin Place diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 31 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the Sydney CBD are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.   
 
From 4am to 11.30am buses will start and end trips at Central instead of Martin Place. Buses to the city will end trips at Central on Pitt St before Hay St (2000434). Buses leaving the city will start trips from Pitt St opp Barlow St (200083).  
 
Catch trains or metro services to continue your trip between Central and Martin Place 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 31 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the city, Darlinghurst and Kingsford are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
 
From 3.30am to 5am buses to the city will be diverting via Gardeners Rd, Botany Rd, Henderson Rd, Wyndham St, Gibbons St, Lawson Sq, Regent St, Redfern St, Chalmers St, Randle St, Elizabeth St then end trips at Central Station, Eddy Ave, Stand A (200039).  
 
Services towards Matraville will start trips from Central Station, Elizabeth St, Stand E (201080) then divert via Redfern St, Regent St, Botany Rd, Gardeners Rd, Bunnerong Rd, then continue as normal. All stops along Oxford St and Anzac Pde will be missed between Kingsford at the city. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions for Sydney Marathon

From 3am to 5am, BN1 buses will start and end trips at QVB instead of Wynyard. Buses will not run to or from Wynyard due to road closures. Buses will use the Harbour Tunnel while the Harbour Bridge is closed.

Catch a train or walk to continue your trip between QVB and Wynyard. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Allow extra travel time as Kiss and Ride upgrade is underway at Leppington Station
infoLinks.content:
Road work is underway to improve the Kiss and Ride zone north of Leppington Station.
  • A reduced speed limit of 40km/h will be in place on the approach to Leppington Station from both directions.
  • A temporary Kiss and Ride zone is available in the commuter car park south of Leppington Station.
  • Access to the multi-storey commuter car park will remain open.
  • Work will take place between 7am to 6pm, Monday to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays.
Please allow extra travel time. View the project page for more information on the upgrade.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD & North Sydney bus diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 31 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads including the Harbour Bridge are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  
From 2am to 12pm, route 290 buses will run to and from Crows Nest only. Buses will not run between Crows Nest, North Sydney and the city.  
 
Buses towards the city will end trips at Crows Nest Station, Pacific Hwy, Crows Nest (206515). Buses towards Epping will start trips from Pacific Hwy opp Crows Nest Station, Crows Nest (206530).  
 
Stops on Sussex St, Clarence St, York St, Blue St, Miller St and Pacific Hwy will be missed.  
 
A limited number of express shuttle buses will operate between Crows Nest and the city via the Sydney Harbour Tunnel in the early morning. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Temporary bus stop closure in North Sydney for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
From 7am Friday 29 August until 2am Sunday 31 August, regular route buses and school buses will not stop on Miller St at Ridge St (206048) as the stop will be closed due to the setup for the Sydney Marathon event start line. 
 
Use the nearby stop opposite Victoria Cross Metro Station, Miller St, Stand B (206083) during this time. 
 
The stop will also be closed between 2am and 12pm midday on Sunday 31 August, while major roads in North Sydney are closed for the Marathon.  
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 31 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads including the Harbour Bridge are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
 
From 3am to 11am, route 172X and 173X services will run between Warringah Mall and St Leonards via North Balgowlah/Balgowlah Shops only. Buses will not run to or from the city.  
 
Services to Warringah Mall will start trips from Crows Nest Station, Pacific Hwy (206515) also stopping at St Leonards Station, Pacific Hwy, Stand C (206521) and along Falcon St in North Sydney. Buses from Warringah Mall will end trips at St Leonards Station, Pacific Hwy. 
 
Catch a train or metro to continue your trip between St Leonards and the city. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details. 
 
Missed stops: 
  • Wynyard Station, York St, Stand M (200035) 
  • Wynyard Station, Carrington St, Stand A (200021)

infoLinks.urlText: Opal can be used between Wollongong and Moss Vale, Exeter and Bundanoon stations.
infoLinks.content:
If travelling by Coach between Wollongong station and Moss Vale, Exeter or Bundanoon stations you can use your Opal card or contactless card or device to tap on or off at your origin/destination station provided the origin/destination is an Opal enabled station.

If travelling onto Goulburn, or other Opal enabled station along the Southern Highlands Line, you should not tap off when transferring from Coach to an Intercity train but instead tap off at your destination station.

Booking is not required for Opal customers on this route.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 31 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the Sydney CBD are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.

From 4am to 3.30pm route 440 services will be split into two routes between Bondi Junction and Woolloomooloo, and between Rozelle and the city (Central/Museum stations). 
  • Rozelle-City: Buses from Rozelle will end trips at) Central Station, Eddy Ave Stand C (200053). Buses towards Rozelle will start trips from Museum Station, Liverpool St Stand G (200072). 
  • Bondi Jct-City: Buses from Bondi Junction towards the city will end trips at Riley St opp Kenndey St (201157). Buses towards Bondi Junction will start trips from Crown St at Robinson St (2010100). 
Continue on foot between Woolloomooloo and Town Hall for connecting buses between Rozelle and Bondi, alternatively consider catching trains to Bondi instead. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

urlText: Chatswood bus diversions for StreetFair
content:
On Saturday 6 September, buses to and from Chatswood will be diverting around a section of Victoria Avenue and missing stops due to road closures for the Chatswood StreetFair.
 
From 12.01am to 1pm and from 4pm to 9pm, services will be diverting via Archer Street, Ashley Street and Anderson Street to and from Chatswood Interchange. Stops on Victoria Avenue between Anderson Street and Neridah Street will be missed.
 
From 1pm to 4pm, services will not run to or from the Chatswood Interchange due to additional road closures. Services to Chatswood will terminate at Johnson Street at Neridah Street (206737) and services leaving Chatswood will start trips at Archer Street before Johnson Street (206796).
 
Check signs at stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Plan your trip using the Trip Planner.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and South East diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 31 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the city, Darlinghurst Moore Park and Kingsford are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
 
From 4am to 3.30pm services will run between Marrickville and Surry Hills only, buses will not run between Bondi Junction and Darlinghurst. Buses from Marrickville towards Bondi will end trips on Crown St at Campbell St (201097).  
 
Buses that usually start from Bondi Junction will start trips from Shannon Reserve, Crown St, Surry Hills (201093).  
 
Go to Central to connect with trains towards Bondi Junction, or catch route 333 buses from Kings Cross station. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: L2 and L3 partial line closures and extra early morning L1, L2, L3 services during Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
Due to major road closures in the city and South East on Sunday 31 August for the Sydney Marathon, L2 and L3 light rail services will be impacted throughout the day. 
 
Additional early morning services will run from 3.45am on L1, L2 and L3 lines. 
 
Services changes, Sunday 31 August: 
  • L2 Randwick Line:  
    • From 3.45am to 11am L2 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall. Services will run between Randwick and Town Hall only. 
    • From 11am, full L2 services between Circular Quay and Randwick will resume as normal. 
  • L3 Kingsford Line:  
    • From 3.45am to 6am L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall. Services will run between Juniors Kingsford and Town Hall only.  
    • From 6am to 11am L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall or between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford. L3 services will run between Moore Park and Town Hall only.  
    • From 11am to 1.30pm L3 services will run between Moore Park and Circular Quay only. Services will not run between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford.
    • From 1.30pm services resume as normal operating between Circular Quay and Juniors Kingsford in both directions. 
Due to major event road closures in the Kensington and Kingsford areas, light rail replacement buses will not be operating. 
 
When L2 and L3 services are partially closed between Circular Quay and Town Hall, use alternative transport including trains or walking if able to. 
 
When L3 services are partially closed between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford, use alternative transport. L2 Randwick Line services continue to run to the city.  
 
Allow plenty of extra travel time as services will be busy. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport information.
infoLinks.subtitle: L2 and L3 partial line closures and extra early morning L1, L2, L3 services during Sydney Marathon

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD & North Shore diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 31 August, buses will be diverting and missing stops due to major road closures in North Sydney and on the Sydney Harbour Bridge for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  
N92 services departing Tallawong at 2am and 3am will operate via the Sydney Harbour Tunnel, ending trips at Town Hall, Park St, Stand K (2000252). Stops will be missed including Wynyard Station, York St, Stand K and Town Hall, Park St, Stand H. 
 
N92 services departing the city at 3.40am and 4.40am to Tallawong will also operate via the Sydney Harbour Tunnel starting trips from Town Hall, Park St, Stand K (2000252). Buses will not stop at Wynyard Clarence St, Stand R. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Mount Kembla bus service changes
infoLinks.content:
Some bus services on route 36, S098 and S101 bus services will terminate earlier and not run after Cordeaux Rd due to roadworks. 

Buses will now terminate at Araluen Avenue, Mt Kembla Village and will not travel beyond this point. 
 
From Thursday 12 June, a shuttle bus will run for school students between Mt Kembla and Cordeaux Rd near Araluen Ave to connect them to their regular school services. The shuttle will depart from Harry Graham Dr at 7.55am each weekday connecting with the S098, and will connect with the S098 and S101 at 3.33pm each afternoon. This shuttle bus is an initiative between bus operator Premier and Wollongong City Council.

Plan ahead and allow extra travel time.

infoLinks.content:

  • Between approximately 5.50pm to 6.20pm, route 546, 549, 550, 600, 601 and 606 services will divert and miss stops while road closures are in place on sections of O’Connell St, Ross St and Victoria Rd for an NRL match at CommBank Stadium.
  • Check signs at stops, walk to nearby alternative stops and see the road closure and transport map and event page for more details.
Closed and alternative stops
  • Parramatta Leagues Club, O'Connell Street will be closed
    – alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills and North West)
  • Our Lady of Mercy College, O'Connell Street will be closed
    – alternative stop O’Connell Street at Fennell Street (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Victoria Road after Villiers Street will be closed
    – alternative stop All Saints Anglican Church, Victoria Road (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Victoria Road before Marist Place will be closed
    – alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills, Epping and Macquarie Park)
subtitle: Parramatta bus diversions for NRL match

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD & North Shore diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 31 August, buses will be diverting and missing stops due to major road closures in North Sydney and on the Sydney Harbour Bridge for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  
607X services departing the city at 3am and 4am will operate via the Sydney Harbour Tunnel. Buses will start trips from QVB, York St, Stand C (200043). Stops at Wynyard will be missed including Clarence St at King St and Clarence St, Stand Q. 
 
The 607X 3.15am service from Bella Vista will run to QVB via Sydney Harbour Tunnel & will not stop at Wynyard. Stops at Wynyard Station, York St, Stand J and QVB, York St, Stand E will be missed. 
 
From 4am to 11am route 607X and 610X services to the city will end trips at Macquarie Park Station, Waterloo Rd Stand E. Buses that to Castle Hill and Bella Vista usually leave from the city will instead start trips from Macquarie Park Station, Waterloo Rd Stand D (2113324). Catch metro services to continue your trip between Macquarie Park and the city.  
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details. 
 
Closed stops: 
  • Wynyard Station, York St, Stand J (200031) 
  • QVB, York St, Stand E
infoLinks.subtitle: Sydney CBD & North Shore diversions for Sydney Marathon
